title: Ninja Crispi £99, Sonos Ace £199 and Dyson Supersonic £199 today
description: Sunday's best UK deals: Ninja Crispi glass air fryer £99, Sonos Ace headphones £199, Dyson Supersonic £199 and Echo Show 8 £119.99 at Amazon.
intro:
**Today's standout is the Sonos Ace noise-cancelling headphones at £199 on Amazon, £150 off, with the Ninja Crispi glass air fryer at £99 the pick for the kitchen.** Amazon's Black Friday Week is now in its fourth day and runs to Cyber Monday (30 November). Late on Saturday it also cut the Dyson Supersonic hair dryer to £199 and the whole Echo Show range, and we've got three more picks for our [Black Friday kitchen spotlight](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/).

Every price below was published on 21 or 22 November 2026 (TechRadar's and T3's Amazon Black Friday live blogs), so check the product page before you buy, as Amazon prices change through the day. Buy now or wait? Black Friday itself (27 November) rarely beats Amazon's Black Friday Week prices on these, so if something here is on your list, there's little to gain by holding out.

deals.name: Sonos Ace noise-cancelling headphones
deals.note: Comfortable over-ears with strong noise cancelling, and they can take over the sound from a Sonos Arc or Beam soundbar so you can watch TV without waking the house. £150 off is the biggest cut we've seen on them.

deals.name: Ninja Crispi 3.8L 4-in-1 glass air fryer
deals.note: Cooks in glass dishes with lids, so leftovers go straight from fryer to fridge and there's no non-stick coating to wear out. A good size for one or two people. £50 off; more models in our [air fryer Black Friday guide](/guides/air-fryer-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Ninja Foodi Dual Zone 7.6L air fryer (AF300UK)
deals.note: Two drawers that cook two things at once and finish together, which is why it's the family favourite. TechRadar says this is Amazon's lowest price this year. See our [Ninja Black Friday guide](/guides/ninja-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Sage The Bambino Plus espresso machine
deals.note: A compact espresso machine that heats up in seconds and steams milk automatically, so it's easy for beginners. It has been cheaper before, but TechRadar notes it hasn't been this low for a couple of years. Compare others in our [coffee machine guide](/guides/coffee-machine-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Dyson Supersonic hair dryer
deals.note: Fast, quiet and controls its heat to protect hair, with magnetic attachments. £100 off at Amazon (T3, 21 November) makes it a strong gift. Styling tools are in our [Dyson Airwrap deals](/guides/dyson-airwrap-deals-uk/) and [ghd Black Friday](/guides/ghd-black-friday-deals-2026/) guides.

deals.name: Suri Core sonic electric toothbrush
deals.note: A slim, refillable sonic brush with plant-based heads and a long battery life, good for travel. A modest saving, but Suri rarely discounts. For round-head brushes, see our [Oral-B Black Friday guide](/guides/oral-b-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Amazon Echo Show 8
deals.note: A smart display for the kitchen worktop: recipes, timers, video calls and a camera view from a Ring doorbell. £80 off. New owners can add an [Amazon Music Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/music/unlimited) to get more out of the speaker.

deals.name: Apple AirTag 4-pack (2nd generation)
deals.note: £18.50 a tag for keys, bags and suitcases, found through an iPhone's Find My app. Easy to split up as stocking fillers.

deals.name: Lego Festive Gingerbread House
deals.note: A cheerful Christmas build to put out every December. 20% off. More sets in our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/).

deals.name: Fairy Platinum Plus dishwasher tablets (150)
deals.note: Not exciting, but 150 tablets works out under 19p each, which is worth stocking up on before the Christmas washing-up.

body:
## Worth waiting for?

Mostly no. Amazon set most of its Black Friday Week prices last week and tends to hold them to Cyber Monday. Headphones and hair tools like the Sonos Ace and Dyson Supersonic are the sort of deal that can sell out of popular colours before Friday, so if you want a particular finish, buy it now.

Many Amazon prices are for Prime members only. If you're not a member, a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) covers the whole sale; our [Prime trial guide](/guides/amazon-prime-free-trial-black-friday-2026/) explains how.

New today: our [Christmas gifts for your girlfriend 2026](/guides/gifts-for-girlfriend-christmas-2026/) guide. This week's spotlight is [Black Friday kitchen deals](/spotlight/black-friday-kitchen-deals-2026/), the dates for every retailer are in [when is Black Friday 2026](/guides/when-is-black-friday-2026-uk/), and every brand guide is on our [Black Friday 2026 hub](/black-friday/).
